messages:
Claire: quick follow-up on prewarm escrow idea. want a tiny, safe proto we can roll to canary. sketch: tokenized lease (ttl), shield_ms, micro-charge on request to deter spamming. open Qs below.

Sam: micro-charge sounds right. keep it as observability-only unless consumed. also need idempotent lease_ids for retries.

Vivian: eviction priority: warmup leases should be lower than reserved but above background. shield_ms small (2-5s) so we don't block critical evictions. track shield_evictions metric.

Zoe: API proposal: POST /escrow -> {lease_id, status}; POST /escrow/{id}/consume -> mark used; DELETE /escrow/{id} -> release. include idempotency-key header.

Claire: simulation plan: replay 7 days mixed-burst trace, run ttl candidates [30s,60s,90s], shield_ms [2s,5s]. compare 99p latency, wasted_warmup_seconds, cost_delta. orch-bot will queue sims.

orch-bot: sim-job 88100 queued (trace: mixed-day-2025, seed:7). ETA ~8h.

Sam: add safety cutoff: if global_ephemeral_cap < 10% disable escrows. also ensure billing only counts reserved + consumed.

Claire: great. i'll draft RFC + rollout checklist for 10% canary. will ping when sims land.
